text: The zero `own_production` **withdrawal** rows on both commissaries were a red herring: that type lives in `dl_cashier_withdrawals`, the **branch cashier** mechanism. Commissaries never use it — they are not routed to the cashier ledger at all (verified: a `production_in_charge` is refused `/daily-ledger/ledger` with 403 and offered `/daily-ledger/admin/commissary` instead).
